title: Review
description: A run's hand-written review: a quality rating plus a markdown writeup. Authored separately from the machine-generated run record and required for a run to be published.

rating.description: The reviewer's one-glance verdict. Never aggregated or used to rank.

writeup.description: The markdown writeup body, with any rating and checklist frontmatter stripped. Must be non-empty.

checklist.description: The reviewer's verdicts on the test case's declared reviewer checklist items (see the version manifest's reviewItems). One entry per declared item; publishing refuses a run whose review leaves any declared item without a verdict. Empty for a case that declares no items.

ReviewVerdict.description: A reviewer's recorded verdict on one declared checklist item.

id.description: The declared checklist item's stable id.

status.description: The verdict: pass (satisfied), fail (not satisfied), or na (does not apply to this build).

note.description: An optional one-line note recording what the reviewer observed.
